Beatrice is shooting with a very difficult director.
I am very afraid things will degenerate there.
I am sorry, but I have an important meeting.
I will have to find someone else.
We do not leave the baby with a stranger!
The old neighbor could look after her.
That makes no sense, Andrea!
I cannot stay locked up twenty-four hours!
A baby needs to be with her mother.
It is not human to always be alone!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Tout le monde en place pour cet après-midi.
examples.trans: Everyone in place for this afternoon.

meanings.note: invariable in the plural; cet après-midi = this afternoon

examples.text: Il y a une autre Clémentine?
L'un à midi, l'autre à deux heures.
examples.trans: One at noon, the other at two.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: elle a besoin d'aide = she needs help

examples.text: Elle a une tête de bébé.

meanings.note: always masculine, even for a girl
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
cela ne change rien = that changes nothing

examples.text: Gardez cela pour vous, s'il vous plaît.
Cela ne change rien au projet.
examples.trans: That changes nothing about the project.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

dégénérer.gloss: to degenerate, escalate, get out of hand

examples.text: Si Sacha les voit, ça va dégénérer.
examples.trans: If Sacha sees them, things will escalate.

meanings.note: je suis désolé(e) = I'm sorry; désolé! alone also works
preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
être enfermé = to be shut in / locked up

examples.trans: She stays shut in at home.

meanings.note: quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later

examples.text: Je ne laisse pas mes enfants à une inconnue!
examples.trans: I don't leave my children with a stranger!

meanings.note: feminine: une inconnue; also adjective: unknown
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Donc je veux vraiment tourner là-bas.
examples.trans: So I really want to shoot over there.

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Ma maman habite dans le Sud.
examples.trans: My mum lives in the South.

meanings.note: often capitalised when addressing her: Maman
nous mangeons keeps 'e' before -ons for the soft 'g' sound
toute la matinée = all morning long
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
dire n'importe quoi = to talk nonsense
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

occuper.gloss: to occupy; to take care of

meanings.en: s'occuper de = to take care of, to deal with

meanings.note: everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid; avoir peur de = to be afraid of
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

meanings.note: in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien

examples.text: Il y a une réunion à dix heures.

meanings.note: before the noun: le seul agent
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
tournez le visage = turn your face

meanings.en: trouve quelque chose = think of something

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: before the noun; vieil before a vowel: un vieil ami
